Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Abolition of Bhagdari and Narwadari tenures. Section 3. Holder of land forming part of bhag, narwa or recognised sub-division and persons in lawful possession of majmun to be deemed to be occupants. Section 4. All other majmun land and other property to be property of the Crown. Section 5. Alienation so far made not to be invalid. Section 6. Custom of female heirs excluded by male heirs void. Section 7. Saving of recognised alienation. Section 8. Method of compensation for the extinguishment or modification of any rights in land. Section 9. Repeal. Section 10. Rules. Section 11. Interpretation.
